description:
What will make you successful for the role:

A C1 level of Italian Language (both written & spoken);
A C1 level of English Language (both written & spoken);
Curiosity, always looking for solutions;
Attention to detail and “willing-to-help” attitude;
Excellent computer skills;

Within your role, you will:

Offer technical support via phone, e-mail or chat;
Answer & solve customers’ inquiries & complaints by offering an accurate solution;
Follow predefined workflows & handle issues specific to each communication channel;
Respond to all customers inquiries within given timescales and efficiently meet deadlines;
Take, register & solve notifications or complaints;
Update the database with all the details about each customer interaction;
Participate in testing/launching/implementing new working products or tools.

Sounds good? Find out what you can get:

Competitive salary package & meal vouchers;
The opportunity to work in a multi-cultural environment;
Private medical insurance;
Everything you want to read from Bookster;
Learning programs for your development;
Wellness activities for your wellbeing.

Be the Heart of Transformation 

At Conectys, you are more than a job title. You are part of a global team that helps leading brands connect with their customers, navigate change, and deliver meaningful outcomes. We create an environment where people continuously learn, embrace new technologies, and build rewarding careers while feeling supported, valued, and included. 

At Conectys, we take pride in our commitment to diversity, equity & inclusion, as we believe it adds value to our organization and enriches each of our lives. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated fairly and with respect, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, religion or belief, sexual orientation, family or caregiving responsibilities, age, disability, or background. We welcome talent from all backgrounds and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for all. 

Conectys is a Business Transformation Outsourcing company that combines human expertise with next-generation technology to help global brands deliver smarter, faster, and more scalable customer experience, content moderation, data annotation, and digital operations across countries, industries, and languages.
